description: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.

en.question: What is burning on the skewer?
